_comment: Copy to <profile>/steward/config.json, chmod 600, fill in. One config per agent.
_bot_token: This agent's OWN bot token. A bot can only delete its own messages.
_owner_id: Numeric Telegram user id of the human who owns these rooms.
_chats: Chat ids this agent is a member of. Never another agent's rooms.
_respect_unread: Skip topics with unread messages so nothing is deleted before the owner reads it.
_collapse_duplicates: Collapsing is opt-in AND requires a signature in collapse_allowlist.
_stale_hours: Unacknowledged critical older than this gets escalated.
